messages:
Aisha (Partnerships): Quick shoutout — Luminexa (SMB health-tech) finished our AWS Marketplace embedded SDK pilot and is live in production 🎉
Priya K. (Onboarding): Nice! They flipped the feature flag this morning and traffic routed to dedicated nodes. No user-impact incidents. :tada:
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): Pushed the small tokenization fix to their model bundle (see diff: changed preprocessing step order). That fixed the 1.2% malformed-output rate.
Liam H. (Infra): Reduced cold-start p95 from ~900ms to ~320ms by tuning the warm pool and changing the scale-down grace period to 45s.
Aisha (Partnerships): Outcome highlights from the pilot: ~2.3x cost reduction vs their self-hosted baseline, p50 generation latency ~120ms, and initial DAU projection ~4k. They signed a 12-month marketplace listing & reserved capacity trial.
Priya K. (Onboarding): Their CS lead said the docs + onboarding script were "slick" — thanks to the template updates. I uploaded the onboarding checklist to the partner drive: https://redwood.example/share/luminexa-onboard
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): Small snippet I ran for repro (for the record):
```
# repro command
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v1","input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```
Ops Bot: deploy/redwood-embed-v1 to luminexa-prod succeeded (job id: d-34921) ✅
Liam H. (Infra): Also set up a canary policy: 5% traffic -> new quantized variant, auto-fallback to float model if error rate > 0.5%.
Aisha (Partnerships): Huge thanks to Priya, Ben, and Liam for the hustle. Can someone DM me a 2–3 bullet internal case note I can share in the weekly all-hands? :pray:  
Priya K. (Onboarding): I'll drop a short blurb in #all-hands in the morning.
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): Will add a technical 2-paragraph note for eng channel with perf numbers.
Liam H. (Infra): Logged the infra tweaks in the ops runbook: /ops/runbooks/luminexa-marketplace.md.
Aisha (Partnerships): Perfect — closing the loop. Tagging for visibility: @here :tada:
